name: v3_source_apply
description: Apply a reviewed standard Git unified diff to an open isolated V3 task; use v3_source_apply_prepared for a prepared_id

patch.description: Full Git unified diff, starting with diff --git a/<V3-relative-path> b/<V3-relative-path>. Include ---/+++ and @@ line-count hunks; new files also need new file mode 100644 and --- /dev/null. Do not use *** Begin Patch, *** Add File, or *** End Patch markers.
